About this Event

Yin and the Holy Ghost

Yoga, Ghost Stories & Messages from Spirit 👻✨Join us for a magical Halloween evening filled with deep relaxation, ghostly tales, and messages from beyond the veil. Think peaceful yoga retreat meets friendly haunted house, minus the jump scares and rattling chains in the attic 🎃
We will begin with Yin Yoga led by Rebecca Risher, an experienced yoga teacher and certified yoga therapist. Through gentle, supported poses, Rebecca will help us release tension, quiet our busy minds, and open ourselves to the spirit realms. No yoga experience is needed. If you can lie on a mat and breathe, you are already highly qualified 💫
Once everyone is relaxed, energetically open, and possibly wondering whether that cold breeze came from the air conditioning, Psychic Medium Nicole Parish will share a couple of eerie ghost encounters from her own life. She will also talk about the thinning of the veil, the belief that the boundary between our world and the spirit world becomes easier to cross during the Halloween season 🔮
We will conclude with a psychic group reading, featuring messages, guidance, and validation from Spirit. We cannot guarantee who may drop in from the other side, but thankfully, they do not require their own yoga mats ✨
Come comfortable, curious, and ready to stretch your body, open your intuition, and perhaps hear from an unexpected guest.
The living are welcome too! 👻
